name: Vocal Cord Harmonic Modification
target_system: laryngeal (vocal cord restructuring for harmonic production)
description: Restructures the vocal cords and introduces a secondary set of vocal folds modeled on songbird syrinx architecture, allowing the user to produce two independent tones simultaneously. The result is a voice capable of natural harmonic singing — overtone chords, dual-pitch speech, and vocal effects impossible for an unmodified human larynx. The modification is valued by musicians, performers, and public speakers. A secondary application is vocal frequency manipulation — trained users can produce infrasonic and ultrasonic components in their speech that cause physiological responses in listeners (unease, calm, attention) without the listener understanding why. Zheng-Dao Bioelectric markets the infrasonic capability as a 'persuasion enhancement' for corporate negotiators, which has drawn ethical scrutiny.
source_organism: Turdus merula (common blackbird), Melopsittacus undulatus (budgerigar, dual-frequency vocalization)
legality: Licensed (infrasonic capability classified as manipulation tool)
procedure: Laryngeal microsurgery with vocal fold duplication, 1 session
expression_time: 4–6 weeks for healing; vocal control develops over 6+ months of training
reversibility: Reversible with vocal cord reconstruction; voice never returns to exact pre-modification quality
side_effects: Voice has a permanent harmonic undertone even during normal speech
Throat fatigue from dual vocal fold use
Accidental infrasonic production during emotional speech — listeners feel uneasy without knowing why
Speaking quietly becomes difficult — the dual folds produce more volume than single folds
Rare: vocal fold desynchronization causing temporary aphonia
social_perception: Admired in performance and music circles. Distrusted in business — the infrasonic persuasion capability makes people suspicious of Siren Voice users in negotiations. Some jurisdictions require disclosure of the modification before legal proceedings.
story_hooks: A Siren Voice negotiator's infrasonic capability is recorded and analyzed by an opposing party — they develop a counter-frequency device that neutralizes the persuasion effect, leading to a sonic arms race in the boardroom
A street musician with the modification discovers they can shatter specific materials with resonant frequency production — their voice is a weapon they didn't know they had
